title: YAWR Conformance Test Vector Schema
description: Single canonical schema for executable Yawr conformance vectors. Invalid vectors must not be executed.

vectors.description: Ordered list of test vectors. IDs must be globally unique and sequential within their file.

TestVector.description: A single, deterministic, self-contained test case. Every field is normative. 'note' is non-normative.

id.description: Globally unique test vector identifier. Pattern: TV-<LANG>-<GROUP>(-<SUBGROUP>)*-<NNN>. Examples: TV-GXL-PARSE-001, TV-GIS-INTERP-042, TV-GCP-RESOLVE-007, TV-PKG-VERSION-001, TV-ENUM-DECL-001. Numeric suffix is zero-padded to ≥3 digits and sequential within its file.

category.description: Coverage category mapped to a distinct runtime concern, including package and enum validation.

description.description: One sentence (≤200 chars) stating exactly what invariant this vector pins down. No vague phrases like 'tests parsing'. Be specific: 'Parser accepts a float literal with negative exponent (scientific notation).'

input.description: For GXL/GIS/GCP vectors: the raw expression, template, or path string under test — exactly as it would appear in the relevant YAML runbook field (after YAML decoding but before GXL/GIS/GCP parsing). For PKG-* vectors (design/yawr/conformance/tv-pkg-resolve.yaml): the workspace-relative POSIX path, within the synthetic filesystem tree supplied in 'variables', of the runbook or config file that is the resolution entry point. Must be deterministic: no timestamps, env vars, randomness.

variables.description: For GXL/GIS/GCP vectors: the variable context map supplied to the evaluator. JSON value model only: null, boolean, number, string, array, object. No special types (no date, no binary). For parse-only vectors where evaluation is not performed, use {} (empty object). Keys must be valid GXL identifiers (ASCII, not a keyword). For PKG-* vectors: a synthetic filesystem tree encoded as a flat map from workspace-relative POSIX path to file content (string), e.g. {"yawr-package.yaml": "...", "tools/kubectl.tool.yaml": "..."}, plus any 'requires:'/'toolRefs:' declarations needed beyond what 'input' already encodes.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON-model value: null, boolean, number (IEEE 754 double, finite), string (UTF-8), array, or object. NaN and Infinity are forbidden.

expected.description: The normative outcome of this vector. For GXL/GIS/GCP vectors: EITHER a success result (value) OR a failure result (error_class + error_code); these two shapes are mutually exclusive. For PKG-* vectors: EITHER the resolved catalog projection (a JSON object under 'catalog') OR a package/plan-time failure ({ error: { code } } using the PKG-*/PLAN-010 codes from design/yawr/sections/03d-parse-time-enforcement.tex). For ENUM-* vectors (design/yawr/conformance/tv-enum.yaml): a passing bound/produced value uses 'SuccessExpected' ('value', optionally with 'warnings': ['ENUM-W001'] for a case-only-distinct enum); a plan-time/runtime enum-constraint failure uses 'ErrorExpected' with error_class 'ENUM' and error_code one of ENUM-001..009; an ENUM-SUBST vector expecting a substitution set-inequality uses 'PackageExpected' with error.code 'PKG-013'.

note.description: Non-normative. Explanation for human readers (contributors, reviewers). Does NOT affect vector semantics. Use for: citing grammar section, explaining edge case rationale, referencing a related open issue.

tags.description: Machine-readable labels for coverage filtering. Examples: 'short-circuit', 'unicode', 'negative-zero', 'OQ1', 'OQ2'. Used by harness --filter flag.

SuccessExpected.description: The input must parse/evaluate successfully and produce the given value or satisfy a deterministic assertion. For TV-GXL-PARSE vectors, value MUST be the string 'parse_ok' (AST shape is implementation-defined). For non-deterministic results, type/assert/pattern pins the contract without requiring exact equality. For an ENUM-* vector (design/yawr/conformance/tv-enum.yaml), 'value' is the bound argument/input value or produced output value that passes its declared enum constraint (post NFC-normalisation of the candidate per AR-ENUM-4); 'warnings' MAY list 'ENUM-W001' when the passing enum is case-only-distinct.

value.description: The expected result. 'parse_ok' for parse-only vectors. Any JSON value for evaluation vectors.

type.description: Expected PJVM type when the vector uses an assertion instead of exact equality.

assert.description: Assertion kind applied by the conformance harness to the produced value.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern used when assert is 'regex'.

warnings.description: OPTIONAL. Non-fatal warning codes that MUST accompany this otherwise-passing result, e.g. 'ENUM-W001' (design/yawr/sections/03d-parse-time-enforcement.tex §Enum Constraint Error Codes) for a case-only-distinct enum vector. Absent or empty means no warnings are expected.

ErrorExpected.description: The input must fail with exactly this error class and error code. error_class is the family prefix (e.g., 'GXL-PARSE', or 'ENUM' for an enum-constraint failure). error_code is the specific code (e.g., 'GXL-PARSE-007', or 'ENUM-008'). GXL/GIS/GCP codes MUST match an error declared in the corresponding grammar file (gxl.ebnf §6, gis.ebnf §5, gcp.ebnf §5); ENUM codes MUST match design/yawr/sections/03d-parse-time-enforcement.tex §Enum Constraint Error Codes. If the grammar is silent, use error_code 'TBD' and set note: 'expected_status: undecided'. An ENUM-RUNTIME vector demonstrating single-cause type-before-enum precedence (AR-ENUM-7) uses this shape with the existing type-error code (e.g. error_class 'GXL-TYPE', error_code 'GXL-TYPE-001'), never an ENUM-* code, since the type error is the one true root cause.

error_class.description: Error family prefix for expression, interpolation, capture, composition, or enum validation.

error_code.description: The precise grammar or enum error code. Examples: GXL-PARSE-007, GIS-PATH-MISSING, GCP-RESOLVE-004, and ENUM-008.

timing.description: Normative phase at which the error is raised when a vector needs parse/eval timing parity.

PackageExpected.description: The normative outcome for a PKG-* category vector (design/yawr/conformance/tv-pkg-resolve.yaml, added per .squad/decisions/archive/barbara-tool-packages-architecture-ruling.md AR-TP-9b §10). EITHER a resolved-catalog projection ('catalog') OR a plan-time failure ('error'). Mutually exclusive.

catalog.description: The expected projection of the resolved catalog (or the relevant slice of it) as a JSON object, e.g. { "kubectl": { "qualifiedName": "acme.incident-tools/kubectl", "tier": 1 } }. Shape is scenario-defined; harnesses compare by deep equality.

code.description: The exact error code from design/yawr/sections/03d-parse-time-enforcement.tex §Error Code Catalog (PKG-* series) or 'PLAN-010'.

warnings.description: The exact, unordered set of non-fatal PKG-W* warning codes that MUST appear in the plan report and trace for this vector. Valid alongside either 'catalog' or 'error'. Absent or empty means no warnings are expected.

JsonValue.description: Any value in the YAWR Portable JSON Value Model (OQ3 — see gis.ebnf §PJVM): null, boolean, number (finite IEEE 754 double), string (UTF-8), array of JSON values, or object with string keys and JSON values. NaN and Infinity are explicitly excluded.
